prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: 1440×900 desktop landing-page north-star comp
Primary request: Design the first two visible folds of a premium fictional general contractor website named NORTHLINE BUILD CO. Visual direction: a working foreman's daily build log translated into an editorial website.
Surface structure: full-width but compact navigation at top; first viewport dominated by one panoramic contemporary residential renovation photograph occupying roughly 55% of the canvas; oversized concise headline “BUILT WITH A PLAN. FINISHED WITH PRIDE.” on the left; one obvious action “REQUEST AN ESTIMATE”; a slim numbered project-phase rail crosses the image and lower hero; below, the next section begins with three services and one field-note annotation. This must read unmistakably as a conversion landing page, not a poster.
Style/medium: high-fidelity web UI comp, desktop landscape.
Color palette: charcoal field-board green #17211B, warm plan paper #F1EAD9, fired clay #C7653D, stone gray #B9B0A0.
Materials/textures: subtle charcoal board grain, warm uncoated plan paper, pencil measurements, restrained inspection stamps. One decisive project photo with natural warm light.
Typography: strong condensed industrial display sans paired with a clean practical grotesk; large but not oversized beyond the viewport.
Text (verbatim): “NORTHLINE BUILD CO.”, “BUILT WITH A PLAN. FINISHED WITH PRIDE.”, “Renovations · Additions · New Builds”, “REQUEST AN ESTIMATE”, “01 DISCOVER”, “02 PLAN”, “03 BUILD”, “04 HANDOVER”.
Constraints: no fabricated testimonials, star ratings, years-in-business claims, license numbers, awards, or numerical project claims; no dashboard cards; no rounded pill buttons; no gradients; no generic orange construction stripe styling. Keep interface text crisp and legible. One dominant move only: the project photo crossed by a construction phase rail.
Avoid: mobile mockup, poster-only composition, 3D device frame, illegible invented text, excessive annotations, stock SaaS layout, bento grid, glassmorphism, watermark.
